{{documentation header}}
<!-- documentation here -->
This template provides a uniform infobox for all [[MCD:Item|''Minecraft Dungeons'' item]] pages.

== Usage ==
The parameter list below may need updating.
<pre style="display:table">
{{Infobox Dungeons item
|title=
|image=
|imagesize=
|image2=
|image2size=
|image3=
|image3size=
|type=
|rarity=
|stat=
|stat1=
|stat2=
|stat3=
|property=
|enchantment=
|soulenchantments=
|runes=
|flavorlabel=
|flavor=
|desclabel=
|description=
}}</pre>

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Function
! Default/Example value
|-
| <code>title</code> || Optional value to use a different title instead of the page name || <code><nowiki>{{BASEPAGENAME}}</nowiki></code>
|-
| <code>image</code> || Image of the item (should be approx. 160x160px) || <code><nowiki>{{{title}}}.png</nowiki></code> if it exists, otherwise [[:File:No image.svg|No image.svg]] (linking to the page where to upload the missing image)
|-
| <code>imagesize</code> || Adjusts the size of the image || 160px
|-
| <code>image2</code> || Image of the item (should be approx. 160x160px) || ''None''
|-
| <code>image2size</code> || Adjusts the size of the second image || 160px
|-
| <code>image3</code> || Image of the item (should be approx. 160x160px) || ''None''
|-
| <code>image3size</code> || Adjusts the size of the third image || 160px
|-
| <code>type</code> || The type of the item || ?
|-
| <code>rarity</code> || The item's rarity || Common
|-
| <code>stat</code> || Which type of stats the item has, this changes what the labels for the stats are named || Melee/Ranged
|-
| <code>stat1</code> || The item's first stat bar || 1-14
|-
| <code>stat2</code> || The item's second stat bar || 1-14
|-
| <code>stat3</code> || The item's third stat bar || 1-14
|-
| <code>property</code> || The item's natural property || None
|-
| <code>enchantment</code> || The item's natural enchantment || None
|-
| <code>soulenchantments</code> || Whether or not the item can have soul enchantments || ?
|-
| <code>runes</code> || The item's runes || ?
|-
| <code>flavorlabel</code> || The flavor text's label. || '''In-game flavor text'''
|-
| <code>flavor</code> || The item's in-game flavor text. || ?
|-
| <code>desclabel</code> || The description's label. || '''In-game description'''
|-
| <code>description</code> || The item's in-game description. || ?
|}
